trustedRunRequired.reason: No benchmark run currently satisfies the trusted-execution boundary. A new real comparison must execute reviewed immutable code without exposing a repository secret to mutable pull-request code.
requiredControls: checked-out HEAD is resolved locally and matches every declared SHA
working tree is clean before execution
provider credential is scoped only to the trusted benchmark process
execution is not a pull_request workflow running mutable head code with repository secrets
result JSON is sanitized and hash-addressed

invalidatedRuns.invalidatedReason: The pull_request workflow checked out mutable PR code and exposed OPENAI_API_KEY to the benchmark step. No credential leak was observed, but the run cannot be canonical evidence.
The repository does not contain a trusted-execution attestation sufficient to promote this run as canonical evidence.

reusePolicy.note: Historical results remain versioned for transparency but cannot satisfy the acceptance criterion until a trusted run replaces canonicalRun.
